card.text: Naked-eye young Sun in Orion, 8.7 parsecs away, whose magnetic field was mapped in December 2017.

sources.label: Willamo et al. 2022
sources.quote: We present five new ZDI maps of young, solar-type stars from December 2017.

introduction.text: χ¹ Orionis is a young Sun-like star 8.7 parsecs away, bright enough to see without a telescope. Its magnetic field may flip every few years.

sources.label: Willamo et al. 2022
sources.quote: This would indicate a rapid magnetic cycle of only a few years, but more frequent mapping would be needed to verify this.
